rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-1 feasibility, per-image N2I rewrite (commit 1f4c3394) on breast_ct (Sidky synthetic breast, 128-view sparse, real-mu range, 512^2) - BILATERAL variant. Short warm-start pre-pass (3 ep x 200 train, GT-free N2I self-sup loss) captures a generic BF-sigma init, then per-scene Adam (n_iter=300) on EACH of 16 val scans' own measurements, scored by evaluate_calibrated on the SAME val scenes as every other breast_ct method. Bilateral stack = 6 trainable params (proj_n_bf=img_n_bf=1, 3 sigma each); ~2x faster than the U-Net N2I. lr=5e-3 per Wagner-2022 BF recipe (solver CONFIG default); BF sigmas left at Wagner abdomen defaults for the iter-1 feasibility seed (the breast-tuned proj_sx=0.01/proj_sy=0.3/proj_sr=0.0005 from solver_dual_ddomain_bilateral_n2i.md hints is reserved as a clean iter-2 one-knob change). grad_clip=1.0 cheap insurance (breast 128-view adjoint is mild vs Mayo 2304-view). Sizing vs smoke: Mayo 2304-view BILATERAL smoke (job 764666) ran 6*... at ~0.125 s/(iter x scene); breast_ct is 128-view (18x fewer angles) so per-step is much cheaper. Steps = warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x300=4800 -> conservatively <700 s at Mayo's bilateral rate, far less on breast's lighter adjoint, well under the claude_agentic_one_iter.sbatch 00:30:00 (1800 s) wall. outer_wall_s=1500 is a hard internal guard on the per-image loop. Hypothesis: per-image bilateral N2I trains stably on breast_ct (finite val_score, comparison.png) and gives a usable per-scene recon; expect hr near the FBP baseline since N2I is structurally bounded by FBP on this dense-view substrate (the prior AMORTISED bilateral N2I was hr=0 / over-smoothing per solver_dual_ddomain_bilateral_n2i.md - the per-image rewrite is what is being tested here).

dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, proj_sx=0.01, proj_sy=0.3, proj_sr=0.0005, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-2, ONE-KNOB change vs iter-1: projection-domain BF sigmas swapped from Wagner-abdomen defaults (proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.02) to the breast-tuned (proj_sx=0.01, proj_sy=0.3, proj_sr=0.0005). EVERYTHING else identical to iter-1 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=img_n_bf=1, 6 trainable BF params, seed=42). FAILURE MODE addressed: iter-1 hr=0 (val_score 0.9720, PSNR 38.17 vs LD-FBP baseline 39.68 - UNDER baseline). solver_dual_ddomain_bilateral_n2i.md Weaknesses + Hints: the Wagner-abdomen proj sigmas (proj_sx=1.0 -> radial blur after FBP; proj_sy=2.0 -> angular over-smoothing) are TOO AGGRESSIVE for 128-view sparse breast-CT - they radially blur the sparse-view reconstruction on top of the existing streaks, smearing fibroglandular detail. The breast-tuned values (proven sensible from breast-ct-claude-agentic-dual-domain-bf-search-20260521-01) shrink proj_sx to near-identity (0.01, avoids radial blur), keep modest angular interpolation (proj_sy=0.3, mild help for sparse views), and tighten the range sigma (proj_sr=0.0005 << data range, preserves the breast/air attenuation edge in the sinogram). HYPOTHESIS: with the proj-domain BF near-identity + edge-preserving instead of radially blurring, per-image bilateral N2I stops smearing the FBP and recovers PSNR toward (ideally above) the 39.68 LD-FBP baseline, lifting hr off 0. WALL: identical step budget to iter-1 (warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x300=4800), which completed in 241 s - far under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged.

dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, img_sr=0.0005, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-3, ONE-KNOB change vs iter-1 (the BEST base: PSNR 38.17 dB, SSIM 0.9720). Knob: image-domain BF range sigma img_sr 0.02 -> 0.0005. EVERYTHING else identical to iter-1 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=img_n_bf=1, 6 trainable BF params, seed=42, proj sigmas back at Wagner-abdomen solver defaults). NUMBERS / WHY NOT iter-2's base: iter-2 tuned the PROJECTION-domain sigmas (proj_sx=0.01/proj_sy=0.3/proj_sr=0.0005) and PSNR went DOWN 38.17->37.90 dB (SSIM 0.9720->0.9680, RMSE up). So the proj-domain BF is NOT the over-smoother to fix here; reverting proj sigmas to iter-1 defaults and keeping iter-1 as the base. FAILURE MODE: hr=0, recon below the 39.68 dB LD-FBP baseline because the 6-param BF degrades an already-decent 128-view FBP. The design doc (solver_dual_ddomain_bilateral_n2i.md Weaknesses) pinpoints the IMAGE-domain BF as the over-smoother on breast-CT: 'Image-domain sigma_x grew 0.5->1.08 in 2 epochs on breast-CT iter-1 - saturating the kernel'; and the doc's own rule 'sigma_r << data range preserves edges; sigma_r >> data range degenerates to a Gaussian'. The CONFIG default img_sr=0.02 is too loose for the breast mu-range, so the image-domain BF degenerates toward a plain Gaussian that smooths ACROSS fibroglandular edges. HYPOTHESIS: tightening img_sr to 0.0005 (<< breast attenuation range) makes the image-domain BF edge-preserving instead of a Gaussian blur, so it stops smearing fibroglandular detail in the FBP and recovers PSNR toward (ideally above) the 39.68 dB LD-FBP baseline, lifting hr off 0. This mirrors the tight range-sigma logic the doc recommends for proj_sr, applied to the image domain where the over-smoothing actually lives. WALL: identical step budget to iter-1/2 (warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x300=4800), which completed in 241 s / 261 s - far under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged.

dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-4, ONE-KNOB change vs iter-3 (the BEST base: SSIM 0.9723, PSNR 38.19 dB). Knob: image-domain bilateral cascade DEPTH img_n_bf 1 -> 3 (6 -> 12 trainable BF params). EVERYTHING else identical to iter-3 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=1, img_sr=0.0005, seed=42, proj sigmas at Wagner-abdomen solver defaults). NUMBERS / TRAJECTORY: iter-1 (defaults) 0.9720 / 38.17 dB; iter-2 (proj sigmas tuned proj_sx=0.01/proj_sy=0.3/proj_sr=0.0005) 0.9680 / 37.90 dB -- proj-domain tuning HURT, reverted; iter-3 (img_sr 0.02->0.0005) 0.9723 / 38.19 dB -- marginal +0.02 dB. hr=0 throughout (all under the 39.68 dB LD-FBP baseline). FAILURE MODE: the 6-param single image-domain BF, even with img_sr now tightened for edge preservation, lacks the expressivity to add detail back to an already-decent 128-view FBP; it can only smooth, so PSNR stays pinned below baseline. WHY THIS KNOB NOW: the design doc (solver_dual_ddomain_bilateral_n2i.md Design considerations) states 'the image-domain stack readily differentiates into a multi-scale cascade (BF1 mild + tight sigma_r, BF2 wider, BF3 widest)' -- a genuine multi-scale denoiser, not just compounded blur. On demo_dl bilateral, img_n_bf is the confirmed working lever (1->3->5: hr 0.67->0.75->0.77, per mayo_campaign_state.md). The prior amortized img_n_bf attempts were at the LOOSE default img_sr=0.02 where the cascade just compounds a Gaussian blur across edges; now that img_sr is tightened to 0.0005 (iter-3), each BF in the stack is edge-preserving, so a 3-deep cascade should add multi-scale expressivity instead of compounding blur -- the one regime where deepening was previously inert/harmful is removed. HYPOTHESIS: with img_sr=0.0005 making each BF edge-preserving, deepening the image-domain stack 1->3 gives a multi-scale edge-preserving denoiser that recovers fine fibroglandular detail and lifts PSNR toward (ideally above) the 39.68 dB LD-FBP baseline, moving hr off 0. If FLAT (PSNR within +-0.05 dB of iter-3), this confirms breast bilateral N2I is converging to its 6-12-param structural ceiling (~0.972 SSIM), mirroring Mayo bilateral 0.9462 / dd-bf-supervised 0.9502 on their substrates -- the BF inductive bias simply cannot beat a clean dense-view FBP, only approach it. WALL: image-domain BF cost roughly triples (still a small fraction of the FBP-adjoint-dominated per-step cost); step budget unchanged (warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x300=4800), iter-3 ran 240 s, so well under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged.
